warning_source: Gaza-border surveillance soldiers and IDF engineering/security personnel
recipient: Gaza Division headquarters and Southern Command headquarters
warning_summary: Surveillance soldiers assessed that repeated Hamas explosive tests at the Gaza barrier were systematic attempts to determine how to breach the fence and were part of a broader operational mission rather than isolated provocation.
evidence_state: Walla 25 Jan 2024 reports from military sources that progressively larger explosive tests near the former Karni crossing prompted a professional assessment that was sent to Gaza Division and Southern Command headquarters; independent Oct 2023 surveillance-soldier testimony corroborates repeated explosives/training observations passed up the chain; a contemporaneous IDF 22 Sep 2023 statement confirms violent fence activity in the period. Published to Notion as Medium confidence.
gaps: No public contemporaneous copy of the assessment or named-officer distribution list; do not infer that it predicted the Oct 7 date, scale or complete invasion plan.

warning_summary: Post-Oct reporting claimed Israel detected a planned Hamas Passover attack, raised alert and caused Hamas to cancel it.
evidence_state: Early post-event reporting described an Israeli alert that supposedly caused cancellation. gaps: Do not accept as a warning event unless primary contemporaneous alert records or later official findings reconcile the contradiction. Preserve both accounts.
